name: theme-switcher
title: Theme switcher
description: Lets people choose system, light or dark theme, stored per device and applied before first paint.

when: An app or site offers light and dark themes.

instead.when: Only two themes exist and the system option is not offered.
The theme choice sits among other account settings.

keyboard.does: Moves between and selects the options.

builtIn: One tab stop; a radio group named "Theme".
System says which theme is in effect now.
